findings.problem: The 'always best' panel turns solid orange at row 1 and reads as the winner (fastest, 12/12, all the best colour). Nothing shows what 'stuck early' means (lost variety), so a first-time learner takes 'too much' as 'great'. The headline 'Too little / Too much' is also never defined: too much of what?
findings.fix: Name the dial in the headline or a tag ('selection pressure'). Add a visible loss-of-variety cue on the always-best panel (e.g. a 'one copy only, no variety left' tag, or a dim, flat colour once every row is identical, plus a short caption such as 'everyone is a copy of one parent'). Reword the verdicts: 'too weak' / 'just right' / 'too strong'.
findings.evidence: lecture-4-s4-5.5.png, s4-9.3.png (always best column all orange, counter 12 / 12, red verdict only appears at 7.0 s)

findings.problem: The orange counters ('2 / 12', '11 / 12') are never explained: nothing says they count copies of the best. Heatmap colour code (deeper green = fitter, orange = original best) is only half captioned, and pale cells in 'random' look like empty/blank cells. Three 8x12 grids growing at once while counters change is a lot to read in 5 s.
findings.fix: Add a tiny label under the counters ('copies of the best') or put it in the caption; add a mini key (pale = weak, deep green = fit, orange = best). Stagger so the learner can read one panel at a time, or give the final hold a bit longer (verdict tags land at 7.0 s with only 4 s to read them).

findings.problem: Heatmap tags start at y~275, only ~20px under the 2-line headline descenders (y~255); cramped top of stage. Same tight gap on scenes 7, 8, 9 and 10.
findings.fix: Start the figure 20-30px lower or shrink the headline gap; the stage has 100+ px free at the bottom in every one of these scenes.

findings.problem: The tick/cross story relies on a before state that is on screen for only ~1.2 s (tiles pop in at 0.6, flip at 1.8). The learner never clearly sees 'old population' vs 'new children' in generational mode, and after the first flip the old row is flipped back (5.0-5.9) with no cue, which looks like a glitch rather than a replay. The 'elite' tag is below 28 px.
findings.fix: Keep a small 'before' row (grey) above the 'after' row for panel A, or hold the original population for ~1.5 s with a 'parents' tag and a 'children' tag when they flip. Bump the 'elite' and panel tags to 28 px.
findings.evidence: lecture-4-s2-2.6.png (mid-flip), s2-5.4.png (flip back to 0.1 0.5 0.3 0.2 0.9 looks like a reset)

findings.problem: Final state of panel A has a purple 0.7 beside the green 0.9 'elite' and no label on what purple means (children). Same unlabeled purple in scene 3 ('the 0.5' child).
findings.fix: One-time legend tag 'child' next to the first purple tile in scene 2.

findings.problem: The grey crosses and green tick under tiles are unlabeled and tiny (about 30 px): learners must guess they mean 'not weaker than 0.5' / 'weaker, found'. A tick turning the tile red at the same moment mixes valid-green with evict-red. The scan is only 0.45 s per slot, so five looks are hard to follow, and panel A shows nothing about what it is checking.
findings.fix: Show the comparison explicitly ('0.7 > 0.5', or a small '<' / '>' badge) or add a caption line 'Is it weaker than 0.5?'. Slow the scan to ~0.7 s per slot, give panel A the same per-slot marker (grey cross on all, red on the weakest) so both panels read alike, and drop the green tick (use red ring only).

findings.problem: Tag labels ('replace first weaker', '0 looks') are about 26 px, below the 28 px floor. During the drop (5.2 s) panel A shows an empty slot and no child, so the row briefly looks like it lost a tile.
findings.fix: Raise tag font to 28 px; keep the evicted tile visible until the child lands.

findings.problem: Wheel slices are near-identical light greys (2 and 5 slices almost the same), so the wheel does not read as slices of different sizes until a slice is picked. Slice numbers are small (about 24 px). The tiny slices on wheel 2 (0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1) are invisible slivers with no labels, and during the morph the percent column shows non-monotonic nonsense (67% / 12% / 21% / 0.1% at 7.5 s).
findings.fix: Give slices distinct tints from the palette (grey, blue-grey, etc.) with 3px dividers, raise slice labels to 28 px+. Interpolate the percent text in the same order as p so it never shows 12% before 21%, or hide the numbers during the morph and show them when it lands.

findings.problem: Spins 1-4 each show a pick, but no tally says 'picked N times'; after spins 3 and 4 the only cue is a thin blue outline on an all-red wheel, and the chip/bar of the 100 stays red (not blue as in the first picks), so the 'picked again and again' point is carried by the caption alone.
findings.fix: Add a small pick tally beside the winning chip (dots or 'picked x2') that increments after each spin; keep the pick colour blue on chip and bar for spins 3 and 4.

findings.problem: Header words 'fitness', 'rank', 'chance' and the knob tick labels 0/1/2 are about 24 px, below the 28 px floor. The ghost dashed marker of the old 99% is a thin black line that is easy to miss and unlabeled. At b = 0 weights show 1 1 1 1 1 and 'total 5' with no caption (last caption ends before 10 s), so the flat-pressure point is silent. The caption 'Roulette: the superfit takes 99%' appears while the bar is still 93%.
findings.fix: Raise all small text to 28 px. Label the ghost marker ('before: 99%') or draw it as a red ghost bar. Add a caption for b = 0 ('b = 0: everyone is equal') and start the knob captions in step with the thumb. Hold the 99% bar at full before the caption begins.
findings.evidence: lecture-4-s6-2.2.png, s6-5.5.png, s6-10.5.png (no caption at b = 0)

findings.problem: Idea of 'sorted by fitness' is not shown: the rank chips just pop in as 5,4,3,2,1 next to the rows. A new learner may not realise rank = position in the sort.
findings.fix: Add a brief sort animation or an arrow 'biggest = rank 5' before the rank chips appear.

findings.problem: The win-chance bars carry no title: nothing on screen says they are the chance each individual is picked as parent, and the bars do not match tile fitness at a glance (#2 with 8 tall, others tiny) without a label. Tick on the winner is dark blue on a blue tile (poor contrast) and sits on the tile corner; the cross on #1 straddles the neighbouring tile. Dice sit at y 255-335, touching the headline descenders.
findings.fix: Add a small tag 'chance to be picked' above or beside the bars. Draw the tick as an -on shade disc off the tile corner or below the tile; move the cross inside the tile outline. Lower the dice row by ~25 px.
findings.evidence: lecture-4-s7-3.6.png, s7-4.6.png, s7-8.5.png (58% label overlaps tank outline)

findings.problem: Knob tick numbers 1-4 are about 24 px. Caption 'A bigger t means tougher competition' fades in grey while the bars are first shown (5.5 s), so the first t = 1 state has no readable caption.
findings.fix: 28 px ticks; start the caption slightly earlier.

findings.problem: Four rows in 12 s is dense (about 1.7 s per row), and each mutation's before value is never held on screen: bit 1 -> 0, 5 -> 1 and 0.20 -> 0.27 change quickly then turn green, so the learner sees only the result and cannot tell what changed or which operator did it. The die for the integer row is gone by the time the value settles. The 'valid tour' badge appears with no matching 'not a tour' badge for the broken re-roll; only the caption says so.
findings.fix: Hold each original row ~1 s before its operator tag, show an old -> new cue on the changed gene (small struck-through old value or arrow), and add the red 'not a tour' badge during the D D state. Consider trimming to three rows plus the tour pair, or extend the scene by 2-3 s.
findings.evidence: lecture-4-s8-2.4.png, s8-3.0.png (die over gene 2 mid-flip), s8-6.5.png (no badge)

findings.problem: First row begins at y~277, right under the headline, and the tour row plus badge fills to y~870; the rows feel packed at the top. 'bit flip' and 'swap' tag columns are not aligned with the real row, where '+0.07' sits mid-row.
findings.fix: Add 20 px top gap; align operator tags in one column.

findings.problem: The uniform-crossover mask does not visibly drive the children: the mask row pops in and the children flip, but nothing links a mask column to its gene (no highlight, arrows or per-column swap). First-time learners will not see why child 1 is A L C D O P G R. Also the ambiguity of which child takes the mask 1: the caption says 'a 1 swaps that gene' but not that child 1 starts as parent 1.
findings.fix: Highlight each mask column and flip the two child genes in that column one by one (left to right) in step with the mask; tint 1-columns lightly. Caption: 'Mask 1 = take from the other parent.'

findings.problem: In the 2-point step the old 1-point children stay while the cut line slides (6.0 s), so for ~0.3 s the children contradict the cut shown. Tags 'parent 1' etc. are about 26 px.
findings.fix: Clear or dim the children when the new tag appears.

findings.problem: 'Fitness: how many pixels match' is not obvious from the picture: empty cells count as matches (hence 88/144 for a random picture), but the learner sees only filled blue cells and red outlines. Recipe tags (steady-state, tournament, mutation / generational, rank, crossover) appear late and are small (about 26 px) and unconnected to the algorithms; the point that the lecture's pieces combine into these two recipes is easy to miss. The left algorithm's slot tag (3,069 evaluations) is below the match counter, so the eye path is long.
findings.fix: Show target heart's blank cells faintly in the target and make mismatches outline both filled and empty cells (already so) but add one line in the caption 'blank cells count too'. Bring the recipe tags in at 1.4 s (with the pictures), at 28 px, tied to the panels. Consider ending with a one-line comparison tag.

findings.problem: The recap covers only three of the lecture's ideas (replacement, selection pressure, operators). Roulette, tournament and crossover, which take 36 s of the video, are not recapped, and the 'tune the selection pressure' pictogram uses the rank knob only. The third row (D A G J E) never ends with the green tick after the swap in the sampled frame, and the lower third of the canvas is empty apart from one pill.
findings.fix: Fold selection methods into card 2 (wheel / tournament / rank mini-icons) and add crossover to card 3, or add a fourth card. Fill the vertical space (cards taller or a fourth row).

findings.problem: Purple is used for four different roles: child tiles (scenes 2, 3), operator tags (scenes 8, 9), parent 2 (scene 9) and rank chips (scene 6). Blue is parent (scene 7), picked slice (scene 5), changed gene (scene 8) and parent 1 (scene 9). Colour meaning is not stable across scenes for a first-time learner.
findings.fix: Pick one story: purple = child/new, blue = parent/picked; recolour operator tags and rank chips (e.g. grey or orange) or at least introduce a legend in the first scene that uses them.

findings.problem: Many tag and axis labels sit around 24-26 px (generational, elite, replace weakest, 0 looks, fitness/rank/chance, knob ticks, recipe tags), under the 28 px rule for labels.
findings.fix: Raise to 28 px or drop secondary tags; check the larger tags for fit.

findings.problem: Title card is fine; subtitle 'Who gets to breed, and how children are made' is clear. The boundary frames at t = 0.3 of scenes 2 and 4 show the headline faded with an empty stage, which is normal for the entrance.
findings.fix: No change needed.
